    # Lowercase the input
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Check if there are any ASCII letters or digits
    has_ascii_letters_or_digits = any(c.isascii() and (c.isalpha() or c.isdigit()) for c in text)
    if not has_ascii_letters_or_digits:
        return ""
    
    # Replace each run of non-ASCII a-z/0-9 characters with one hyphen
    result = []
    prev_was_hyphen = False
    
    for char in text:
        if char.isascii() and (char.isalpha() or char.isdigit()):
            # ASCII letter or digit - keep it
            result.append(char)
            prev_was_hyphen = False
        else:
            # Non-ASCII or non-alphanumeric - replace with hyphen if not already adding one
            if not prev_was_hyphen:
                result.append('-')
                prev_was_hyphen = True
    
    slug = ''.join(result)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    
    return slug"}
